description: Segmented one-time-code input: one cell per character, auto-advance on typing, Backspace steps back, arrow/Home/End navigation, optional grouping separators and masking.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The complete verification code. Equals the concatenation of all cell values.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Fires when the code changes (every accepted or removed character).

parameters.name: Length
parameters.description: Number of cells. Must be between 4 and 10; other values throw ArgumentOutOfRangeException.

parameters.name: Kind
parameters.description: Which characters are accepted (Numeric: ASCII digits; Alphanumeric: letters normalized to uppercase plus digits) and which keyboard is presented via inputmode.

parameters.name: GroupSize
parameters.description: Renders an aria-hidden separator between groups of this many cells (0 = no separators).

parameters.name: Masked
parameters.description: Renders every cell as type="password" so the code is hidden while typing.

parameters.name: Disabled
parameters.description: Disables every cell and applies the tm-otp-input--disabled root modifier.

parameters.name: ReadOnly
parameters.description: Renders every cell readonly and applies the tm-otp-input--readonly root modifier: the code stays visible and focusable but cannot be edited.

parameters.name: Invalid
parameters.description: Error state: applies the tm-otp-input--invalid root modifier (with the shake animation) and sets aria-invalid="true" plus an aria-describedby pointing at the ErrorText message on the group and every cell. Setting Invalid=true WITHOUT ErrorText is the supported way to surface a message owned by a surrounding TmFormField (reachable through the host AriaDescribedBy). The message text is announced through a single always-rendered polite live region; call ShowErrorAsync() to replay the shake and re-announce an unchanged error.

parameters.name: ErrorText
parameters.description: Error message rendered below the input (and announced politely) while Invalid is true. Localize it through ITmLocalizer; null or empty renders no error element and adds no {Id}-error reference — use that when a surrounding TmFormField renders the message instead.

parameters.name: Verified
parameters.description: Verified state: blocks editing (the cells become readonly), applies the tm-otp-input--verified root modifier and renders the localized verified status (check icon + text) below the input, referenced from every cell through aria-describedby="{Id}-status" and announced through the polite live region.

parameters.name: AutoFocus
parameters.description: Moves focus to the first cell after the first render.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: HTML id attribute of the root group.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class(es) applied to the root element.

parameters.name: AriaLabel
parameters.description: aria-label of the group. Defaults to the localized "Verification code" label; ignored when AriaLabelledBy is set (the reference wins per WAI-ARIA).

parameters.name: AriaLabelledBy
parameters.description: aria-labelledby of the group. When set, AriaLabel is not rendered.

parameters.name: AriaDescribedBy
parameters.description: aria-describedby of the group (e.g. a hint or error message id).

parameters.name: OnComplete
parameters.description: Fires exactly once each time the code transitions from incomplete to complete; clearing a character and completing again fires it again.

parameters.name: DataTestId
parameters.description: Overrides the root data-testid.

parameters.name: TestIdPrefix
parameters.description: Namespaces every internal data-testid as "{prefix}-{name}".

parameters.name: AdditionalAttributes
parameters.description: Additional attributes applied to the root element.

methods.name: FocusAsync
methods.description: Moves focus to the first empty cell (selecting it); a complete code focuses the first cell. No-op while Disabled.

methods.name: ClearAsync
methods.description: Clears every cell, raises ValueChanged with the empty string, syncs the DOM (one batched setCellValues call) and re-arms OnComplete. No-op while editing is blocked.

methods.name: ShowErrorAsync
methods.description: Re-triggers the invalid shake (JS reflow restart) and re-announces the error message: the single polite live region is cleared for one render and then restored, because it only announces changes. Call after (re)applying Invalid/ErrorText when the same error is already shown.
